description: Publishes a revocation already signed by an owner key or by an agent key (this door holds no keys and signs nothing): it withdraws a mandate, stops an agent key, or declares an owner key stolen. It is sealed in the register and applies from its position there; records sealed before it stay valid. There is no undo. Submit it only if your owner or the signer asked you to.
name: symbolon_submit_revocation
title: Publish a revocation
